summary: Master Project Portfolio Management Training to prioritize initiatives, strengthen governance, and deliver clearer executive reporting. Enrol now.
lede: Project portfolio management helps teams select, sequence, and govern projects so the combined workload fits strategic priorities and available capacity. The course is for portfolio managers, PMO analysts, programme managers, sponsors, and strategy professionals who need to make funding and resource choices more transparent. It covers weighted prioritization, capacity and dependency planning, and portfolio governance and performance reporting through exercises such as building assessment matrices and executive reports.
audienceIntro: This course is built for professionals who already work with projects, programmes, or PMO reporting and now need stronger Project Portfolio Management Training capability. Portfolio Managers who govern initiative selection and balance strategic demand. PMO Analysts who maintain portfolio registers, dashboards, and reporting packs. Programme Managers who manage interdependent initiatives across the portfolio. Project Sponsors who approve funding and escalation decisions. Strategy Managers who connect portfolio choices to corporate objectives. Portfolio Analysts who score initiatives and maintain prioritization models. PMO Directors who oversee governance cadence and executive reporting. Finance Business Partners who review portfolio funding cases and investment trade-offs. Resource Managers who allocate scarce capacity across programmes. Transformation Leads who coordinate multi-project change agendas.
prerequisites: Participants should bring a laptop, a spreadsheet tool such as Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, and if available a sample portfolio register or initiative list. Prior exposure to project or programme environments is recommended, but no programming or advanced analytics background is needed.
